# AgentLoom integration patches

The recursion, final-pool construction, anonymous selection, reflection parser, Library and logical ledger remain owned by the pinned upstream method.

- Package installation preserves this core and its license/provenance in AgentLoom wheels.
- Pi is an explicit proposer channel with an injected host transport; upstream workspaces, retry, cache, audit and harvest remain in use. Host interruptions bypass retry and candidate fallback.
- The explicit Application surface accepts declared resources and allowed new paths, preserves binary assets, and delegates application-specific validation to the existing benchmark adapter seam. Other surfaces retain their original rules.
- Optional development feedback is written into a separately identified evidence directory and replaces the contradictory answer-free prompt paragraph only in that mode. Selection feedback uses the same anonymous IDs as its artifacts. All other evidence retains leak and grader tripwires.

These are transport, resource, and evidence extensions; there is no alternative scheduling or scoring controller.
